UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_ReadOnly: Read-only local snapshot. No food or inventory changes.
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_NoApple: No apple was found in the inspected inventory entries.
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_Ownership: Directly in this player's main inventory
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_Weight: Weight matches its registered item definition
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_Nutrition: Nutrition values are readable and finite
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_WholeUnproven: Matching checks cannot rule out every partial-use or custom transformation.
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_NoStation: No rack selected. Inspect a rack to view station checks.
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_StationCompon: Drying and item-resource components are present
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_AccessUnprove: Pathing, ownership and server authorization are not checked by this preview.
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_NoProcessing: Drying is not available. Production recipes, output creation and server validation remain blocked.
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_FirstApple: This station report inspects only the first apple found directly in your main inventory. Inspect individual apples from inventory for exact selection.
UI_foodWorks_DryingPreview_ScanLimited: The bounded inventory scan reached its limit. Other apples may exist outside the inspected entries.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_Start: Dry one apple (first fresh apple in main inventory)
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_InvalidState: This exact apple batch is unavailable or its saved state is unsupported.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_AccessDenied: Stand on the rack tile or beside it, with no wall, window or door between you and the rack.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_InvalidSettings: The server apple-drying settings are invalid.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_Disabled: New apple-drying batches are disabled by the server.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_RackBusy: Apple drying needs an empty, unlocked small-plant rack with no native craft running.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_InvalidApple: Use one whole, fresh, unmodified apple from your main inventory. Cooked, frozen, poisoned or unsupported food is rejected.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_Capacity: New drying batches are unavailable. Finish existing batches or ask the server admin to check saved drying data.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_OperationFailed: The drying action failed. Check the console and inspect the actual item before retrying.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_Started: Apple drying started. Its time and shelf-life settings are saved with this batch.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_NotReady: This batch is not ready to collect. Progress: %1%.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_Cancelled: Drying cancelled. The actual apple keeps its age and food values.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_drying: Apple drying: %1%. Unloaded racks and long observation gaps pause progress.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_ready: Apple drying time is complete; check the rack to finish the conversion.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_converting: This batch needs to finish processing. Check the rack again, or return the carried batch to an empty rack.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_done: Dried apple slices are ready to collect.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_failed: This batch stopped without producing dried food. Cancel to recover the actual aged apple.
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_Resume: Return carried drying batch to this rack
UI_foodWorks_AppleDrying_Resumed: Returned the same apple batch. Earned progress is retained; carried time is not credited.
